title: The Iron Triangle of U.S. Healthcare: Economics, Policy, and Technology
summary: Structural analysis of U.S. healthcare economics, policy, and technology.

children.text: The U.S. healthcare system operates as an 'Iron Triangle'—a rigid tension between cost, quality, and access. Realignment requires a systemic shift across Economics, Policy, and Technology.

body.title: Podcast: Breaking the Policy Deadlock
body.summary: An analytical breakdown of the legislative hurdles facing healthcare transformation.

children.text: Policy is the economic architecture of care.
